It is a reminder that just as a laurel wreath was given as a symbol of triumph to the victorious in ancient Rome, Christians are given the ultimate victory through faith in Jesus Christ. The name Lorie calls to mind the promise that God is our shield and refuge, and he will protect and uphold us in all our ways.
